summary: Rabbi Soffer goes through the Mishna and Gemara in Masekhet Bechorot, focusing on the laws of Pidyon HaBen when there is uncertainty regarding birth order or paternity. He examines cases involving multiple wives and husbands, the status of the child's redemption if the father or child passes away, and the prioritization of the obligation to redeem oneself versus one's son.
questions: If a father pays for Pidyon HaBen and the child passes away within 30 days, does the Kohen return the money?
What happens if a father has two wives and two boys are born, but we do not know which child is the firstborn?
Does a father have to redeem himself if he was never redeemed as a child?
If a father has only enough money to redeem either himself or his son, who takes priority?
Is a child considered redeemed if the father pays the money on the 30th day?
